method: Each physical step advances the actual ThermalRuntime.sync; no seasonal seeking, parameter reinitialization, disabled routing or replaced model.

physicalGrid.budget: whole-cell stores and equal-area global ledger

displayGrid.area: spherical row quadrature; inventory downscaling is a display estimate, not the conserved physical ledger

seasonalMonthNote: Month zero begins at the vernal equinox (orbit phase 0); approximate DJF uses bins 9-11, JJA bins 3-5. Monthly rain is accumulated actual step flux, not a smoothing window.
regionNote: Regional rectangles clip both grids by spherical area. Greenland bounds can include neighboring coarse mixed cells; coverage is a model diagnostic, not a satellite extent product.

inventoryDefinitions.shelfIce: separate floating ice inventory; excluded from seasonal sea ice extent
inventoryDefinitions.snowCoverage: conditional land snow water equivalent >= 30 mm
inventoryDefinitions.seaIceExtent: ocean area in cells with ice concentration >= 15%
inventoryDefinitions.seaIceArea: ocean area multiplied by model ice concentration; 0.5 m inventory maps to full concentration

budget.sensibleLayers: separate air, land and ocean reservoirs
